name: Kanto Rocks
description: ROXIE came to JOHTO looking for a scene and found temple bells and a sleeping WOOPER. So she is starting a band, and you are her manager. Recruit the members, promote the gig, then find out what happens when PIERS turns up to crash the encore. Early days: v0.2.x introduces ROXIE herself, in VIOLET CITY, once you have a badge. Quest System is optional -- with it installed the questline also keeps a journal entry.
